diagnosis: The healthcare portal mounts clinicApp on '/clinics/:clinicId/departments', but the rescheduling route updates appointment objects solely by appointmentId. It fails to verify that the appointment belongs to clinicId, deptId, or the authenticated patient. An attacker can reschedule or disrupt medical consultations of other patients across different clinics.
